'''Transport CT-05''' was a [[New Republic]] [[transport]] [[starship|ship]] used in the [[Corellia]] [[shipyard]]s to transport heavy parts from a [[sector]] to another. The transport was heavily [[weapon|armed]] with twin fire-linked [[turret]]s on its wings as well as on its rear to defend against pursuers, and possessed a [[hyperdrive]] unit that allowed it to jump between [[star system]]s. 

==History==
[[File:Ct-05_on_the_eye_of_sion.png|left|thumb|240x240px|CT-05 loading an SSD hyperdrive core into the ''Eye of Sion'']]
Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Ahsoka date">{{AhsokaSeriesDate}}</ref> CT-05 was tasked by an [[Morgan Elsbeth's forces|Imperial remnant]] with transporting a refurbished [[Super Star Destroyer]] (SSD)'s hyperdrive core to the [[Denab system]] to be incorporated in the ''[[Eye of Sion]]'', an [[galaxy|extragalactic]] transportation vessel meant to retrieve the [[Galactic Empire]]'s last [[Grand Admiral]], [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] from a distant galaxy. Former [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], with the help of [[New Republic]] [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]] uncovered the plot and attempted to stop the transport from departing; when they failed to do so, Syndulla's [[astromech droid]] [[C1-10P]] instead planted a [[homing beacon]] on its [[hull]] to track it to its destination.<ref name="Part Two">{{Ahsoka|Part Two: Toil and Trouble}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
CT-05 first appeared in [[Part Two: Toil and Trouble]], the second episode of the [[Disney+]] television show [[Star Wars: Ahsoka|Ahsoka]], which premiered simultaneously with [[Part One: Master and Apprentice]] in [[August 22]] [[2023]].<ref name="New Release Date">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1692552080764887366|Star Wars|quote=Thank you to all the fans who celebrated with us at our @AhsokaOfficial fan events around the world last night! We’re excited to announce that new episodes of #Ahsoka will now launch Tuesdays at 6PM PT, starting with our two-episode premiere on August 22, only on @DisneyPlus.|archivedate=20230818152836}}</ref>
